plan.summary: This 1-4 block is a simple off-camp boxing strength and power build around one weekly S&C session, with volume kept moderate so it does not compete with sparring. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lower-body lift, then the main program starts in Week 2 with crisp power work first, steady strength work second, and brief accessories after. Review bar speed, soreness, and sparring quality at the end of Week 4 before the next block.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body strength and simple explosive ability without adding unnecessary fatigue to boxing work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress force and power with slightly heavier main work while keeping the weekly dose recoverable.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Turn the earlier strength gains into faster, sharper outputs with lower fatigue and high intent.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a low box you can land on quietly. Reset between reps and focus on fast takeoff and clean landings.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with small jumps in load, then perform one hard top set with clean depth and posture. This session establishes your baseline for future loading.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your training max.
